overview.headline: Heterozygosity, gene pools and human genetic diversity

keyPoints.point: Allele variation is critical for species survival and adapting to changing environments
keyPoints.quote: The variation in alleles is critical to the survival of a species and allows organisms to adapt to changing environments.

keyPoints.point: Every diploid cell carries two alleles, one inherited from each parent
keyPoints.quote: Every diploid cell has two alleles, one inherited from each parent.

keyPoints.point: Possible genotypes can be calculated from allele number with formula k(k+1) over 2
keyPoints.quote: and can be calculated using the formula k(k+1)/2, where k is the number of alleles at a particular locus.

keyPoints.point: Approximately 85% of human genetic diversity comes from individuals of the same population
keyPoints.quote: The study of genetics has revealed that approximately 85% of human genetic diversity comes from individuals of the same population.

keyTerms.gloss: having two different alleles at a specific locus
keyTerms.quote: If an individual has two different alleles at a specific locus, the individual is heterozygous at that locus

keyTerms.gloss: having the same two alleles in an individual
keyTerms.quote: if the two alleles are the same, the individual is homozygous

keyTerms.gloss: unique set of alleles found across every member of a species
keyTerms.quote: A gene pool is the unique set of alleles that could be found by analyzing the DNA from every member of a species or population.

keyTerms.gloss: probability of transmitting genes to the next generation
keyTerms.quote: Fitness is the probability of transmitting one's genes to the next generation in relation to the average probability for that population.

keyTerms.gloss: grid that graphically represents expected genotypes
keyTerms.quote: A Punnett square is simply a grid that graphically represents expected genotypes.

analysis.pageCoverage: Explains heterozygosity, allele frequency, genotype counts, Punnett squares, gene pools, fitness and human diversity distribution
